One concept per file. Every file is self-contained: set the keys it names and
run it.

```bash
python examples/01_skill.py
```

A **Skill** is the atomic unit — one prompt template, one model, one result.

| File | What it shows | Keys |

| [`01_skill.py`](01_skill.py) | Run a prompt against a model. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |
| [`02_skill_models.py`](02_skill_models.py) | Same prompt, three providers. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` `OPENAI_API_KEY` `GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY` |
| [`03_skill_multimodal.py`](03_skill_multimodal.py) | Text → Image → Text, three different providers. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` `XAI_API_KEY` `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` |
| [`04_skill_save_load.py`](04_skill_save_load.py) | Save a skill to YAML, reload and run it. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |
| [`19_image_edit.py`](19_image_edit.py) | Image → image (editing) across four providers, one Skill. | any one of `OPENAI_API_KEY` `GOOGLE_AI_API_KEY` `XAI_API_KEY` `DASHSCOPE_API_KEY` |

A **Chain** runs steps in order; each step's output flows into the next.

| [`10_chain_save_load.py`](10_chain_save_load.py) | Save a chain to YAML, reload and run it. | `OPENAI_API_KEY` `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |

## Agents

An **Agent** runs one loop: each turn the model calls tools or answers, and `stop_when` decides when the run ends.

| File | What it shows | Keys |
|---|---|---|
| [`13_agent.py`](13_agent.py) | Basic agent with one tool. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY` |
| [`14_agent_tools.py`](14_agent_tools.py) | Agent with multiple tools, picks autonomously. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY` |
| [`15_agent_orchestrator.py`](15_agent_orchestrator.py) | Orchestrator agent spawns sub-agents. | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` `PERPLEXITY_API_KEY` |
| [`22_goal_mode.py`](22_goal_mode.py) | A stop condition the harness can verify | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` |
| [`24_scaffold.py`](24_scaffold.py) | Scaffold — the model designs the team, then runs it | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |

## Pause and resume

A **Chain** can park itself until a signal arrives — a person, a webhook, a cron tick — and be resumed later, in another process, from a shared store. An agent does not park: its state is the conversation.

| File | What it shows | Keys |
|---|---|---|
| [`17_chain_human_input.py`](17_chain_human_input.py) | Human-in-the-loop: pause a chain for manual input. | `OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| [`18_chain_external_trigger.py`](18_chain_external_trigger.py) | Pause a run until an EXTERNAL trigger resumes it. | *(none)* |

---

## Quick reference

```python
from yait_aichain import Agent, Chain, Model, Pool, Skill
from yait_aichain.agent import step_count
from yait_aichain.pool import DONE, FAILED
from yait_aichain.state import FileStore, SuspendedResult
from yait_aichain.tools import Wait

# Skill — one prompt, one model
skill = Skill(model=Model("claude-sonnet-4-6"), prompt="Summarise: {text}")
result = skill.run(variables={"text": "..."})

# Chain — sequential steps
chain = Chain(steps=[skill_a, skill_b])
result = chain.run(variables={"topic": "..."})
print(chain.history)          # one record per step

# Pool — parallel execution
pool = Pool(skill, items=[{"text": t} for t in texts], max_flows=10)
results = pool.run()
print(pool.status)            # {PENDING: 0, RUNNING: 0, DONE: 5, FAILED: 0}

# Agent — one loop, tools or an answer each turn
agent = Agent(Model("claude-sonnet-4-6"), tools=[...], stop_when=[step_count(10)])
result = agent.run("Research the top 3 vector databases.")
print(result.output, result.stopped_by, result.tokens_used)

# Pause / resume — a chain parks until an external signal arrives
chain = Chain(steps=[draft, Wait(reason="approve?"), send], store=FileStore("runs/"))
result = chain.run(variables={"complaint": "..."})
if isinstance(result, SuspendedResult):
    # ...later, possibly in another process sharing the same store...
    chain.resume(result.run_id, signal={"reply": "approved text"})
```
